description:
## Return YouTube Username v2.2.7

- Fix Active Live Chat Name Resolution: Fixed an issue where active live broadcasts only stripped the '@' symbol without displaying the real channel name. Now properly resolves and caches official channel names on the background layout thread with fast early-termination stream parsing.
- Performance Optimization: HTML stream parsing now breaks immediately upon extracting channel metadata (saving ~80-100KB per request and reducing latency to ~500ms).
- Pure Standalone Morphe Patch Bundle (~21 KB): Fully compatible with Morphe 2.1.0+ and YouTube 21.30.216.
